title: Lexicon Survivors — 600-panel story art commission
image_policy: Each record is a separate image request. Do not combine prompts into atlases or reuse an image.
style_lock: Hand-authored high-quality pixel art that matches the exact in-game sprite identity; 640x360 logical canvas enlarged 2x nearest-neighbor to 1280x720; consistent crisp cluster scale and no in-image text/UI.

inky.identity_lock: Small, youthful adult scholar with a bright, readable face; deep cobalt-blue robe; short blue cape; pointed cobalt hat with a crisp gold brim and one small gold quill pin; simple belt and compact silhouette. Preserve the in-game blue-and-gold color blocks. Keep Inky visually distinct from Neris and from every other hero.
inky.campaign: Mira'yı bulmak; onun adına karar vermeden, kendi seçimini ve ortak anılarının gerçekliğini öğrenmek.

quillmaster.identity_lock: Lean adult duelist in a dark wine-red coat, black gloves and narrow boots; dark hair; a short white feathered quill cap angled over the brow. Carry a slim quill-rapier. Keep the red, charcoal and ivory silhouette from the in-game sprite; never borrow Inky's hat.
quillmaster.campaign: Ada'yı geri çağırmak yerine, ona verdiği emirlerin izini sürüp kız kardeşinin kendi yolunu seçme hakkını kabul etmek.

word_knight.identity_lock: Broad, compact adult knight in polished silver plate; unmistakable blue helmet with a short red plume; deep teal-green cape; round brass-rimmed shield and a heavy dictionary blade. Preserve the silver/blue/red read of the game sprite and its grounded, weighty posture.
word_knight.campaign: Eski nöbet yeminindeki zorlayıcı emri açığa çıkarıp kapıları korumayı insanların seçim hakkını korumaya dönüştürmek.

rune_sorceress.identity_lock: Clearly adult woman mage with a calm, focused expression; layered midnight-blue robes; pale blue hood and crescent-shaped hat; fine gold edging; a violet rune-orb held near one hand. Use the in-game blue-and-violet identity. Her mother Lale is older, silver-lavender, and never a duplicate.
rune_sorceress.campaign: Annesi Lale'nin kayboluşunu izlemek ve onun seçimini, geride bıraktığı mühürleri çözerek anlamak.

lexicon_alchemist.identity_lock: Adult woman field alchemist in a moss-green hood and short green mantle; warm brown leather belt with two or three glass vials; one small round brass lens/goggle; sturdy gloves. Keep the green-and-ochre game-sprite silhouette. Avoid adding a large hat or a wizard staff.
lexicon_alchemist.campaign: Kardeşi Lio'nun anısını bir şişede hapsetmeden, onu kendi sesi ve tercihleriyle serbest bırakmak.

shadow_lexicographer.identity_lock: Slim adult shadow-lexicographer in a close black hood, face mostly in shadow with one cool-blue eye glint; a single deep-red scarf tail and red accent on the dark coat; narrow calligraphy katana. Keep the black/red silhouette from the game sprite. The double has the same build, not a new monster.
shadow_lexicographer.campaign: Kendi yazmadığı emirleri ve Neris'in kaydındaki izi izleyip gölgesiyle eşit söz hakkını paylaşmak.

reference_npcs.neris: Neris is a clearly adult woman: dark wavy hair tied low with one distinct silver forelock, green eyes, a tiny ink mark on her left cheek, forest-green archivist coat, cream ruffled collar, small antique-gold key pendant and a narrow shoulder strap. Keep her face and silhouette consistent.
reference_npcs.mira: Mira is a separate adult woman, not Neris: short copper-brown curls, warm amber eyes, indigo-blue scarf, ink-stained cuffs and a small star-shaped pen charm. Her body language is independent, often turned toward a door she chose herself.
reference_npcs.ada: Ada is a distinct young adult woman: short auburn bob, red-brown work jacket, a pale thread bracelet with two knots, quick observant eyes. Her posture shows agency; she is never framed as an object to retrieve.
reference_npcs.lale: Lale is Rune Sorceress's mother, an older woman with silver-lavender hair, a violet ceremonial mantle, weathered hands and a cracked family seal. Keep her older than the hero and visually unmistakable.
reference_npcs.lio: Lio is Alchemist's younger brother: a young man with short unruly chestnut curls, freckles, a faded sea-green laboratory coat and mismatched glove cuffs. Draw him as a warm memory, not a childlike mascot.
reference_npcs.shadow_double: Shadow Double matches Shadow Scribe's height, hood and face shape exactly, but is edged by a muted wine-red rim light and stands as an equal person, not a hostile clone or a possession.
reference_npcs.blank_page: Blank Page / Whisper is a quiet adult-height figure in layered ivory paper-fiber robes, with a smooth unmarked void where a face would be. Use folded page edges and negative space only; no letters, file icons, emoji, logos, fake writing, or monster-mouth caricature.

upload_policy.source: Keep approved lossless PNG originals in an external/source archive, not in the runtime download path.
upload_policy.runtime_format: After human visual approval, export a 1280x720 WebP with pixel edges preserved; target <= 300 KB each.
upload_policy.lazy_loading: Load only the active comic panel image and at most the next panel; never preload all 600 images.
upload_policy.runtime_wiring: When approved files exist, map each five-dialogue beat to its own image; never point the runtime at a missing requested file.

Create exactly ONE finished, hand-crafted high-resolution pixel-art graphic-novel panel, 16:9 landscape, for the Lexicon Survivors game. This is a single scene image, never a contact sheet, sprite sheet, collage, UI mockup or icon.

For boss continuity, consult the exact in-game sprite assets/sprites/upgrade_v2/boss_red_inquisitor.png and detailed model sheet docs/story-art-600/references/bosses/red_pen_inquisitor.png (Red Pen Boss; judgment skill). Treat those game files as the identity source; do not invent a replacement design.
